run_generate_scene_text_embeddings: run the script to generate CLIP text embeddings for 3D scene utterances from CSV and JSON datasets
create_normalize_caption: create a function that normalizes a caption by lowercasing and removing punctuation and spaces
build_load_utterances: build a loader that reads utterances from CSV and JSON split files across multiple 3D vision datasets
run_distributed_embedding: run distributed text embedding generation using jina-clip-v1 across multiple GPUs with accelerate
save_embeddings_hashes: save generated text embeddings and MD5 hashes to a PyTorch checkpoint file on the main process
